findings: Neutral shoulder/hip centers remain skeletal while compatible bulk and arm clearance vary.
Split-limb material and antialias seams exposed by primary inspection are repaired with a shared world-space material and one combined visible path.
The complete person remains illustrated/mannequin-like; full naturalism and empirical body fitting are still open.
Card backgrounds previously used undefined --surface and were transparent; --panel supplies coherent visible backgrounds.
Border and text colors preserve the locally inherited tokens. Enabled/disabled controls and wrapping remain readable in inspected desktop/mobile originals.
Existing light-theme body token overrides root accent presets, so light non-gold selections still inherit gold. This is a separate verified defect, not fixed or hidden by the local token checks.
Light body tokens previously shadowed selected non-gold accents; actual descendant values now agree with root in all ten palettes.
Mobile Advance Week previously inherited black ink; primary theme ink and stronger fill retain at least 4.5:1 contrast in all ten measured palettes.

Representative actual game/landing desktop/mobile originals show readable controls and intact layout. Landing can show Continue Franchise after league creation; it is not a screenshot of a fresh blank setup form.
Actual portraits, measured front/profile body and all six movement modes now use one saved shared-head mesh, through front/profile camera projections.
Head-only geometry excludes fixed prototype neck and training top; production measured SVG neck/jersey remain authoritative. Camera fit places crown/chin at canonical mounting landmarks.

Before captures route the image helper to null, exercising unchanged legacy builders; after captures use current production helper. Mobile waits use actual mode authority to account for the 150ms debounced resize.

Selected-person renders show anatomical volume but remain mannequin-like, with shallow eyes, simplified lips, broad beard coverage and weak neck/body material continuity. Complete naturalism is not accepted.
Cached modern PNG heads currently lose the former automatic CSS eye blink; explicit blink poses are supported, but automatic presentation remains required.
A draw/context error selects legacy fallback for the session. Malformed iris/complexion are rejected without disabling a healthy renderer; full recovery/device testing remains required.

Fresh actual desktop dark and mobile light open/closed originals inspected; screenshots use controlled poses, while separate assertions verify the live automatic controller and fault during its fully closed pose.
Eye closure and exact reopening are visible; complete head retains shallow eyes, puffy closed folds, simplified anatomy and weak head/body material continuity.
One retained CPU mesh serves multiple projections and blink poses; one canvas/context is retained and GPU state is recreated after restoration.
Reduced motion restores the original neutral PNG even while graphics is unavailable; hidden/offscreen/detached controllers stop scheduling.
This selected-person browser proof does not establish population frequencies, all hairstyles, cross-device behavior, full career continuity or convincing complete-player craft.
Softer connected eye/cheek/nasal/perioral relief and a Cupid-shaped lip mask reduce the older exaggerated ridges and oval mouth marks. Nose wings and nostril shading are less isolated.

Final three-person color/clay front, three-quarter and profile comparisons contain zero exposed globe pixels on full closure and exact reopening. Actual dossier and movement projection remain coherent.

Intermediate multisample edge runs failed on small oblique/profile globe contributions. Reviewer isolated exact triangles; single-sample 240 and 960 probes were zero for one person. Final rendering uses single-sample depth; the production PNG atlas remains 440x880, twice its SVG dimensions, with display resampling. Final actual dossier edges were inspected as acceptable for scoped progress.

Lids/globe now share lateral samples and closed vertical knots; GPU margins resolve identical saved coordinates. A small radial shell clearance preserves outer attachments. Reduced tessellation of the unused linear prototype neck keeps the established mesh budget; measured production body remains authoritative.

Complete faces still look planar/mannequin-like, with cap-like hair, sparse beard volume, simplified ear form, rigid expression and weak measured neck/body material continuity. Full craft is not accepted.
Controlled fixture colors and artistic geometry are not empirical demographic or body calibration. This selected-person game proof is not final current career, all-device or whole-suite evidence.
Head lighting formula is centralized without intentionally changing its numerical model; measured SVG skin uses camera-space curved-section samples from the same diffuse/specular model.

Actual head, neck and body pigment presentation is closer, and arms/legs read more rounded. The burst under-jaw stroke is replaced by a bounded neck-only occlusion fade. Eight original before/after/gallery captures were inspected across ordinary desktop/mobile sizes and both themes.

No measured body path or saved player DTO change in the actual dossier comparison. Legacy renderers and graphics-unavailable output remain available. Three gallery fixtures demonstrate material coherence, not a statistically representative population or frame distribution.

Per-bone SVG normals, far-layer occlusion and neck shadow remain artistic approximations, not a complete 3D body or scanned athlete fit. Complete bodies, hands/joints and faces remain stylized/mannequin-like; cap-like hair, painted/sparse beard volume, simplified ears and rigid expression need further craft.

Independent reviewer reported two pre-existing whole-head aperture/hash fixture failures while confirming immediate-before fallback equivalence. They remain adjacent verification work; this component does not refresh those expectations or claim whole-suite acceptance.
Front auricles now have a rounded external outline rather than narrow bars; color/clay comparisons preserve the same saved head in front, oblique and profile.
Actual dossier portrait/front/profile/movement retains source identity and API DTO. Small body-view ears remain subtle; the profile interior is still stylized and line-like.

All 12 current gallery originals and 24 actual before/after originals were inspected across desktop/mobile and dark/light. Body/motion captures provide integration evidence, not exact synchronized pose-pixel equality.
Cartilage sizes, inclination, concavity and local shading are artistic assumptions; no measured ear anatomy, population occurrence or medical inference adopted.
Cap-like hair, painted/sparse beard, rigid expression and mannequin-like bodies remain complete-player craft defects. This ear component does not close them.
Compared six grooming styles on identical anatomy, plus two other saved fictional people. Beard/goatee has front/profile volume rather than only skin pigment and sparse dots.
Mustache remains a small split strip, cheek/chin transitions are stylized and long-beard surface can read as a fitted shell. Full hair/beard/face/expression/body naturalism remains open.
Actual dossier is readable on both themes and viewport sizes; measured front/profile/motion uses the same person. Body/motion snapshots do not establish synchronized pose equality.
Root inspected nine controlled gallery originals and sixteen actual originals. Other retained captures are explicitly uninspected, not counted as root image acceptance.
All dimensions, density and strand detail here are artistic; no population frequencies, individual body composition or grooming prevalence adopted.

Root inspected eight fresh R2 originals: full-beard desktop dark gallery, goatee mobile light gallery, actual mobile portrait and movement plus desktop body in both themes. Other retained R2 captures are explicitly uninspected.
Beard has shared fitted volume; mustache tips clear the saved lip form. Surface still reads as a smooth cap/striated shell in some views and the mustache is line-like. Full naturalism remains open.
Actual dossier preserves readability and shared geometry; body/motion snapshots do not establish synchronized pose equality. Artistic geometry is not measured grooming prevalence.
Six gallery originals and six actual dossier originals inspected across desktop/mobile and dark/light; remaining 72 retained originals are explicitly uninspected.
Hairline edge is less uniform; braid paths now run from crown and loc tips are less tightly curled. Dark hair has subtle strand contrast.

Afro silhouette still reads swept/cap-like, braids remain smooth cap with thin rows, locs retain a broad cap and sparse dangling ends, and long hair remains visibly sparse. These style-recognition/naturalism defects remain open.
Face, beard and measured body remain mannequin-like; current improvement does not meet complete-person craft.
Actual dossier remains readable with shared head in front/profile/movement. Asynchronous screenshots do not prove synchronized pose equality.
All geometry and coverage thresholds remain artistic assumptions, not country/NFL prevalence or measured anatomy.

Braid rows have greater visible thickness; broad cap-like areas and simplified braid construction remain.
